name: H4. Lab abnormality patterns
rawText:
# Do you know which laboratory tests reveal the highest rates of abnormalities across different diagnosis categories?
#  - Which laboratory tests have the highest abnormal result rates?
#  - Which diagnosis categories are most frequently associated with abnormal laboratory results?
#  - Are certain laboratory tests consistently producing abnormal results across different diagnosis categories?
#  - How frequently are abnormal results observed compared with all tests performed?
#  - How do average observed test values compare with their reference maximums?
#  - Which test and diagnosis-category combinations show the most concerning abnormality patterns?
#  - Are there specific laboratory tests or diagnosis categories that deserve closer clinical investigation?
# __________________________________________________

LabAbnormalityPatterns is LabResults:
    TestName,
    Visit.Diagnose.Category DiagnosisCategory,
    Count(Id) TestCount,
    CountIf(IsAbnormal = <True>) AbnormalCount,
    (CountIf(IsAbnormal = <True>) * 100.0 / Count(Id)).Round(2) AbnormalPercent,
    Avg(ResultValue).Round(2) AverageResult,
    Avg(ReferenceMax).Round(2) AverageReferenceMaximum
  Where Visit.Status = <Completed> AND Count(Id) >= 5
  Order AbnormalPercent DESC, TestCount DESC
  Take 10
